tools.name: get_protocol_manifest
tools.description: Return canonical protocol identity and SHA-256 metadata.

tools.name: load_protocol
tools.description: Load the complete, unmodified canonical protocol text.

protocol.description: Canonical protocol to load in full.

tools.name: verify_protocol_integrity
tools.description: Validate canonical protocol structure and optionally match its SHA-256.

expected_sha256.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 digest that must match exactly.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed citations and return stable PMIDs with explicit pagination and access state; no medical conclusions are generated.

date_range.description: Inclusive publication-date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

page_size.description: Requested records per page; allowed range is 1 through 100.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous PubMed search.

tools.name: fetch_pubmed_record
tools.description: Retrieve one PubMed citation by PMID, preserving only metadata PubMed supplies and making no full-text or medical inference.

tools.name: search_europe_pmc
tools.description: Search Europe PMC records while preserving provider source identifiers and cursors with explicit pagination and access state; no medical conclusions are generated.

date_range.description: Inclusive publication-date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

page_size.description: Requested records per page; allowed range is 1 through 100.

cursor.description: Opaque Europe PMC cursor returned by a previous search.

tools.name: search_clinical_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov studies with provider pagination and explicit access state; no medical conclusions are generated.

page_size.description: Requested studies per page; allowed range is 1 through 100.

page_token.description: Provider page token returned by a previous ClinicalTrials.gov search.

tools.name: fetch_clinical_trial
tools.description: Retrieve one ClinicalTrials.gov study by NCT ID, preserving supplied metadata without medical inference.

tools.name: resolve_doi
tools.description: Resolve a DOI or bibliographic citation through Crossref metadata; no medical conclusions are generated.

doi_or_citation.description: DOI URL, doi: identifier, bare DOI, or bibliographic citation.

tools.name: check_retraction_status
tools.description: Check traceable Crossref update metadata for a DOI without inferring validity, safety, or medical conclusions.

identifier.description: DOI URL, doi: identifier, or bare DOI to inspect.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Search YouTube videos and return API-visible metadata with explicit pagination and access state; no medical conclusions are generated.

page_size.description: Requested video results per page; allowed range is 1 through 50.

cursor.description: Opaque YouTube page token returned by a previous search.

tools.name: get_youtube_video
tools.description: Retrieve one API-visible YouTube video by supported ID or URL without interpreting its content or making medical conclusions.

video_id_or_url.description: Supported YouTube video ID, youtu.be URL, youtube.com watch URL, or YouTube Shorts URL.

tools.name: get_youtube_comments
tools.description: Retrieve all API-visible YouTube top-level comments and, by default, every independently paginated reply with explicit completeness accounting; no medical conclusions are generated.

video_id_or_url.description: Supported YouTube video ID, youtu.be URL, youtube.com watch URL, or YouTube Shorts URL.

include_replies.description: Fetch every independently paginated API-visible reply; defaults to true.

cursor.description: Opaque YouTube commentThreads page token at which retrieval begins.

tools.name: search_youtube_comments
tools.description: Retrieve a query-bounded API-visible YouTube comment-thread subset and independently paginate replies with explicit partial coverage; no medical conclusions are generated.

video_id_or_url.description: Supported YouTube video ID, youtu.be URL, youtube.com watch URL, or YouTube Shorts URL.

include_replies.description: Fetch every independently paginated API-visible reply; defaults to true.

cursor.description: Opaque YouTube commentThreads page token at which retrieval begins.
